title: CTV Video Spot with Shoppable QR Code
summary: A 14-second CTV video with an on-screen QR code and a scannable end card that drives viewers from the TV to their phone.
description: A sample of our MP4 video format for CTV and streaming. Built from licensed stock footage to show the format: a QR code appears in the corner mid-spot and the end card turns the full screen into a scan-to-order call to action, so a lean-back TV view becomes a measurable visit. We deliver spots like this as broadcast-ready MP4s with the QR code, tracking and end card built in.
